description:
I'm a Computer Science graduate from Morocco interested in AI, data science, and technology. For NASA Space Apps 2026, I want to use Earth observation data to discover environmental trends and develop innovative, impactful solutions.

I'm looking for motivated teammates with skills in Python, data analysis, environmental science, web development, or data visualization. Beginners are welcome if they're curious, creative, and ready to collaborate. Let's turn Earth data into meaningful discoveries!
